items.abstract:
<jats:title>Summary</jats:title>
                  <jats:p>Both full waveform inversion (FWI) and iterative direct waveform inversion (IDWI) were suggested for reconstruction of velocity model using seismic data. In FWI algorithm, the partial derivative wave field of parameter is used to define the amplitude of update. On the other hand, IDWI is different from FWI algorithm in the way that the partial derivative wave field of virtual scattering source is used instead of that of parameter. FWI and IDWI have pros and cons, respectively. In this paper we suggest a new strategy to adopt IDWI and FWI algorithm sequentially to remedy their shortcomings.</jats:p>
title: Iterative direct waveform inversion (IDWI) plus Fourier-domain full waveform inversion (FWI)
